value.rationale: The inverse count is a central local invariant of the very inverse graph used to prove existence of permutation matchings, not a chosen arbitrary statistic. The finding gives an explicit exact all-order moment law for every rank and size, a sharp finite extremal criterion, and a nondegenerate scaled limiting distribution for every fixed rank. The law describes quantitative heterogeneity ignored by existence results and has a clear future use in sampling/random local matching constraints.
